title: Fixed Trailing Edge Panel — Doubler Repair at the Fairing Attachment Land

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Fixed Trailing Edge Structure

abstract: Permanent doubler repair for fastener hole elongation in the fixed trailing edge panel at the flap track fairing attachment land, where buffet loading works the joint on high cycle aircraft.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the bearing capability of the fixed trailing edge panel at a flap track fairing attachment land after fastener hole elongation has been found, without replacing the panel.
sections.damage_assessment: Measure the elongation of each fastener hole in the attachment land with the bore gauge, and record the direction of the elongation as well as its magnitude. Elongation up to the allowable limit below may be reamed to the first oversize and left. Elongation beyond that limit, or elongation at more than three consecutive holes, is repaired by this scheme. Damage that reaches the panel edge, or that lies in a land that has already been reamed to the second oversize, is outside the scope. Inspect the doubler already fitted at the land, if any, before you decide, because the repair cannot be stacked.
sections.repair_procedure: Remove the flap track fairing and support the panel. Remove the fasteners at the affected land and inspect each hole by eddy current. Ream each hole to the first oversize and repeat the eddy current inspection; a hole that still shows an indication is outside the scope. Cut the doubler D5730110727626 to the layout of the repair drawing and offer it to the inner face of the panel over the affected land. Drill and ream the new fastener positions using the doubler as a template, keeping the edge distance on the drawing and staying clear of the rib foot. Add the strap HADE644828-78 across the land where the drawing calls for it on a land with more than three affected holes. Deburr every hole and apply the surface protection of the standard practice. Install the doubler and the strap wet with sealant, using screws LN717472-3E at the accessible positions and tubular spacers AGS824926K1 where the grip has to be made up. Restore the sealing at the fairing attachment and refit the fairing. Set the fairing alignment to the dimensions in the applicable maintenance task before you torque the attachment fasteners.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is life limited to 14 000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment. Do a repeat eddy current inspection of the reamed holes every 4 000 flight cycles and a detailed visual inspection of the doubler perimeter at every heavy check. Any new elongation at a reamed hole invalidates the repair and the panel must then be replaced. Report the repair to Aeralis with the elongation measurements taken before the repair.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Fastener hole elongation up to 0.4 mm at no more than three consecutive holes in one land, with no crack at any hole and no damage within 25 mm of the panel edge.
